$schema-note: Sustainable FSA house-style design tokens, v0.1.0. Machine-readable mirror of theme/sfsa-theme.css for non-vanilla consumers (Tailwind config, Quarto SCSS, R/ggplot2 and matplotlib palettes, email hex tables, print specs). Keys are the CSS custom-property names with the leading '--' stripped: 'bg-deep' is var(--bg-deep). Values are byte-identical to the CSS. The CSS is the source of truth; change both together. Structure ported from mt-climate-office/mco-web-style (MIT), tokens/tokens.json.

themes.$note: Two themes. 'light' is the DEFAULT and lives on bare :root in the CSS (no data-theme attribute needed). 'highContrast' is [data-theme="high-contrast"] and is WHITE-based max-contrast, not MCO's black-based theme. Every key must exist in BOTH blocks; tokens with no theme variant live in themeIndependent instead and are exempt from that parity rule.

themeIndependent.$note: CSS custom properties defined once on :root with no theme variant. Exempt from the both-themes parity check. --sheet-h is a runtime slot: JS stamps the open bottom sheet's height on :root so the MapLibre bottom corner controls and the toast lift above it; the 0px default keeps every calc() inert.

zIndex.$note: One ladder for every floating surface. Add to a tier, never invent a number. MapLibre's vendor .maplibregl-ctrl-* containers ship at 2; map popups ship with none.

breakpoints.$note: Informational; the CSS @media rules are the source of truth. 'compact' must stay in sync with viewport.COMPACT_MQ in core/core.js and with the §6 comment in theme/sfsa-theme.css. The numeric entries are max-widths in px.

fonts.$note: One self-hosted variable font covers the whole 100-900 axis, so heading-weight 900 costs no extra request. The @font-face src in theme/sfsa-theme.css is relative to the stylesheet ('fonts/roboto-v51-latin-wght.woff2'), which keeps a snapshotted copy of theme/ working from any origin. Preload it with crossorigin (see snippets/head.html).

contrast.$note: Measured sRGB WCAG 2.x ratios, foreground on [bg-deep, bg-surface, bg-raised]. The contract: text-primary/text-secondary/text-muted >= 4.5 on all three; text-dim >= 4.5 on deep and surface (it clears raised too); accent-line >= 4.5 on all three; ctrl-border >= 3 (non-text, 1.4.11); text-on-accent >= 4.5 on accent. accent, accent-light and sage are FILL/LINE grade only.
